2608.02184.title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
2608.02184.paper_summary: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.
2608.02184.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們考慮參數合成和優化問題，針對參數馬可夫決策過程（pMDPs），這是經典MDPs的擴展，其中確切的概率值被參數表達式所取代。計算將參數估值映射到PRCTL屬性$\lsf$的滿意度值的有理函數$f_{\lsf}$是一項計算上昂貴的任務，特別是對於pMDPs而言，最佳策略可能在參數空間中有所不同。我們採用\emph{情境方法}來有效合成一個可能近似正確（PAC）近似$\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$的$f_{\lsf}$：通過對參數配置進行取樣並解決線性規劃，我們獲得一個多項式近似，其誤差範圍$\margin$在指定的置信度下對於除了一個$\errorRate$比例的參數域在取樣分佈下是有保證的。我們進一步展示了如何將這個PAC框架與統計模型檢查（SMC）結合，從而使黑箱參數模型的分析成為可能。在PAC近似的基礎上，我們整合了DIRECT（DIviding RECTangles）算法，用於在參數空間中的無導數全局優化。我們建立了條件最優性差距保證：在明確的Lipschitz和PAC良好集假設下，真最優值$f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$與DIRECT找到的值之間的差異由一個分區直徑項界定，而在PAC情況下，還有一個額外的近似誤差項。對2997個基準的實證評估專注於新的基於DIRECT的優化組件。結果顯示，DIRECT變體解決的實例數量少於情境優化器，但在它們共同成功的實例中，通常返回略佳的目標值，並且通常運行速度更快，同時在PAC範圍內保持接近情境值。
